proposed_summary_record_schema.schema_dialect: JSON Schema 2020-12; supplementary strict JSON/semantic requirements below
strict_JSON_rules: UTF8; unique object keys; finite numbers only, no NaN/Infinity
reject bool as numeric/integer; no type coercion
require exact bound run/session/profile/epoch and approved source mode; strings are labels, not authentication
reject derived overflow and unknown profile/scaler/model; syntax alone never confers permission
proposed_summary_record_schema.missing_policy: Existing target requires finite summaries even for mask0. Raw missing/null cannot be translated until A chooses a reviewed new profile/missing representation; omit no fields, fabricate no zeros/ranges/masks.
causal_rules: summary tick is last-included acquisition, never transmit/receipt time
future records excluded only after complete validation; duplicates merge per exact source policy
one transportseq is not one nativeEM acquisition; hold never creates independent fresh evidence
do not use current pose, geometry, future outcomes or privileged source callbacks as acquired features
proposed_summary_record_schema.profile_admission: blocked pending D1-D4; this document changes neither TelemetrySchema nor current strict9/strict13 nor C22 factory/API
